description: Region of Emilia-Romagna publishes building roof-face polygons and their boundary representations from the DBTR topographic database, with 2008, 2013 and other published metadata versions. Roof faces are bounded by roof perimeter, ridges and valleys. Coverage is Emilia-Romagna. The physical roof geometry provides building-stock inputs for building energy performance or exposure simulations. The grouped resource has 6 native metadata entries; versions, map sheets and complementary representations are retained together where the provider defines the same resource. The metadata permits public access and states a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Metadata is publicly readable; charges for obtaining or using the underlying material are not established here. Access is through the linked native metadata, which lists the provider routes and declared formats. Openings and roof structures do not interrupt roof-face continuity in the source definition. This is geometry, not measured energy performance, structural strength or a current completeness guarantee. Accuracy and current completeness remain unverified. No distribution, map, feature or document body was downloaded. Descriptive metadata dates range from 2014-12-15 to 2025-08-25; these dates are not treated as asset observation dates. Related regional or municipal inventories describe other physical assets or broader source catalogues.
